summary: Timed animation-value query wrapper. Reads the current timer value through MutexGuardedTimerRead on the object pointed to by *this (this+0x0), passes it together with a3 and a4 into PhysicsQueryGetterWithReadyFlag, and fills the caller-supplied output a2 with an 8-byte (double) value on success, returning 1; on query failure returns 0 without writing a2.

local_names.this: handle whose pointee supplies the timer source at +0x0
local_names.a2: float output buffer receiving the queried value as a double
local_names.a3: first argument forwarded unchanged to PhysicsQueryGetterWithReadyFlag
local_names.a4: second argument forwarded unchanged to PhysicsQueryGetterWithReadyFlag
local_names.v4: timer value captured by MutexGuardedTimerRead before the query
local_names.v6: stack buffer that the query fills with the returned value

operations.description: MutexGuardedTimerRead(*this): reads the guarded timer value from the object referenced by this+0x0
PhysicsQueryGetterWithReadyFlag((int)v6, a3, a4, v4): fills the v6 stack buffer, forwarding a3, a4 and the captured timer value
When PhysicsQueryGetterWithReadyFlag returns 0 the function exits early with 0 and leaves a2 unwritten
On success the 8-byte value in v6 is copied into the caller's float buffer a2
Return 1 on success, 0 on query failure
Used by RunCollisionDetectionLoop (0x0045F390) and SessionSynchronizer (0x0045F950) to fetch a timed animation value during their per-frame work
